title: The 8 Best Saw Horses 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for saw horses 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at saw horses 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT Stanley DWST11031 Adjustable Metal Legs Sawhorse
products.blurb: Key specs: 1,000 lb pair capacity, Folding legs, 16-inch top.
strengths: 1,000 lb combined capacity handles full sheets and heavy lumber without flexing
Wide 16-inch top provides stable support for wide panels
Folds flat for truck or van storage
The most commonly used job site sawhorse for professional contractors
limitations: Plastic construction lighter than metal alternatives
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Kreg KWS1000 Mobile Project Center
products.blurb: Key specs: Project center, Built-in clamps, Multiple configurations.
strengths: Built-in clamps hold workpieces in multiple orientations -- correct for cutting and routing without separate clamps
Configures as a standard sawhorse, assembly table, or clamping fixture
The most versatile sawhorse design for a home woodworking shop
Kreg quality and design refinement
limitations: More complex to set up than standard folding sawhorses

products.name: Bora Centipede Folding Work Table CK625
products.blurb: Key specs: Folds flat, Multiple widths, X-fold design.
strengths: X-fold design collapses to 2 inches flat -- thinner than any other sawhorse
Multiple width configurations for different material sizes
Correct for supporting full 4x8-foot sheets for cutting
The most space-efficient sawhorse for storage in a tight shop
limitations: Less stable than traditional sawhorse designs

products.name: STANLEY FATMAX Folding Metal Sawhorse (Pair) FMST1-75672
products.blurb: Key specs: 1,000 lb pair capacity, Steel reinforced top, Folding legs.
strengths: Steel-reinforced top rail -- more durable than plastic tops for saw blade contact
1,000 lb pair capacity
Tool tray stores accessories while working
The most available non-DeWalt sawhorse at retail
limitations: Less common than DeWalt in professional settings

products.name: Woodstock D4220 Sawhorse Brackets
products.blurb: Key specs: DIY bracket kit, Lumber construction, Any height.
strengths: A shop-built sawhorse using these brackets can be made to any height, width, and capacity
Custom height is the most important advantage -- standard sawhorses are often too tall or too short
Building sawhorses is a practical first woodworking project
limitations: Wooden sawhorses are heavier than plastic alternatives

products.name: Keter Folding Compact Adjustable Workbench Sawhorse Work Table with Clamps
products.blurb: Key specs: Adjustable height, 1,500 lb pair capacity, Aluminum top.
strengths: Adjustable height is the most important practical advantage over fixed-height sawhorses
1,500 lb capacity -- the highest capacity pair
Aluminum top rail is durable and resistant to saw blade damage
The correct sawhorse for shops where different working heights are needed for different tasks

products.name: Bora Portamate Speedhorse Sawhorse Pair with 50-inch NGX Clamp Edge
products.blurb: Key specs: Assembly table use, Included NGX clamp edge track, Metal top for 2x4.
strengths: Included NGX clamp edge accepts clamps and doubles as a straight-cut guide for circular saws
Metal top rated for 2x4 support without additional clamping hardware
Can be positioned side by side to form a flat assembly surface
The correct pair for woodworkers who use their sawhorses as an assembly surface
limitations: Less common than DeWalt at retail
Clamp edge accessory is only useful when using the sawhorses as an assembly or cutting surface

products.name: Black and Decker Workmate 225 Portable Project Center
products.blurb: Key specs: Clamping vise top, 550 lb capacity, Folds flat.
strengths: The clamping vise top grips workpieces for sawing, drilling, and assembly
The classic portable workbench design that has been in production since the 1970s
Folds flat for storage and transport
The correct portable work surface for apartment woodworkers and those without a shop
limitations: Less capacity than standard sawhorses for supporting large panels
Single unit, not a pair -- designed as a standalone work center, not a panel support
